risk_statement: AI produces an unsupported investigative claim
proposed_control: Require event-ID grounding and human verification

risk_statement: Malicious instructions embedded in event text influence output
proposed_control: Separate untrusted event data from system instructions

risk_statement: Unapproved security-event data reaches external model
proposed_control: Default deny data export with approved allowlist

risk_statement: Assistant receives unauthorized Splunk or endpoint permissions
proposed_control: Use read-only identity and deny side-effect tools

risk_statement: Model or prompt update changes observed behavior
proposed_control: Record versions and rerun regression tests

risk_statement: Private or personal data appears in public evidence

proposed_control: Maintain normal SPL and manual fallback

risk_statement: Automated action wrongly blocks an account or service
proposed_control: No autonomous security actions; explicit human review
